YOUR WINGS. YOUR RULES.

Flight school.

01

Take the lead

Your reticle follows your ship. Lead moving targets and avoid terrain. Gold rings repair shields; weapon cores upgrade your lasers.

LEFT STICKWASD / ARROWS
02

Pulse & lock

Tap for pulse lasers. Hold to fire and charge while acquiring a target; release a locked charge for a homing burst.

R2SPACE
03

Change your pace

Boost to clear danger. Brake to line up a shot. Both use thrust; release to recharge.

× BOOST / □ BRAKESHIFT / CTRL
04

Make some space

Nova bombs clear nearby enemies and projectiles. Save one for a heavy formation or boss core.

○B
05

Do a barrel roll

A rolling wing reflects enemy fire. Time it just before impact to keep your shields intact.

L1 / R1Q / E
06

Find another way

When the canyon forks, choose your path: left along Turquoise Run, or right through Needle Ridge. Both routes lead to the Citadel.

LEFT / RIGHTCHOOSE AT THE FORK
07

Keep the wing together

Clear enemies pursuing your wingmates. Call for a wing assist every 30 seconds. Rescue bonuses and chained kills build your score.

△ WING ASSISTF / 30 SECOND COOLDOWN
08

Break the Citadel

Read its attack patterns. A cyan core is shielded; fire when it opens orange. Roll through volleys and keep moving.

ORANGE = EXPOSEDOPTIONS / ESC PAUSES

Behind the glow.

FOXGLOW is an original arcade flight demo inspired by the expressive flying, wingmate chatter and branching adventure of StarFox 64. Original characters, worlds, models and music.
